question: The Government of India set up a committee to review the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act 2003, under the Chairmanship of NK Singh, in the year __ __ .
solution:
The correct answer is **' __2016__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• In 2003 and 2016, the **NK Singh Committee** on FRBM Act was established to evaluate the FRBM Act.
 
• Nand Kishore Singh, a former revenue and expenditure secretary, served as the committee's chairman. 
 
• Under N.K. Singh's leadership, the **FRBM Review Committee **was established in 2016 with the task of reviewing the Fiscal Responsibility & Budget Management (FRBM) Act. ​
 
• The FRBM Act was passed in 2003, and the government decided to examine it in 2016 because of the amount of time that had passed since it went into effect.
 
• The Indian economy, which had expanded and was now more favourable to foreign investment than it had been in 2003, had undergone significant changes since the act's enactment.
 
• Former **RBI Governor Urjit Patel** and former Finance Secretary Arvind Subramanian were among the committee's other members.
